doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: Third Street Record Store and Sun Ra's impact
summary: Allen says the band sold records at the Philadelphia store and that Sun Ra changed people's lives, his included.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: Did you ever go to the, in Philadelphia, the Third Street Record Store?
Yeah we used to have our records — I had a big poster down there. Yeah, we used to sell records there.
Well the owner, amongst other people I’ve spoken to said, “Well a Sun Ra concert changed my life.” It had that —
It did a lot of things to different people, it did something for different people. It changed mine too. You see?
